description: This source file defines an enumeration 'FilterFunctions' that implements 'FilterFunction', providing supported filter functions such as 'eq', 'ne', and 'like'. It includes methods to retrieve functions by name and to apply them, serving as a factory or registry for filter functions within the project.

classes.name: FilterFunctions
classes.description: An enum implementing 'FilterFunction' that provides filter functions 'eq', 'ne', and 'like' with lookup and application capabilities.

methods.name: fromName
methods.description: Static method to retrieve a filter function based on its name, returning an Optional containing the matching FilterFunction if found.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the filter function, delegated to the underlying 'rqlFunction'.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the filter function with given parameters, delegating to the underlying 'rqlFunction'.
